messages:
Ellen (Sales): Hey finance  dinner with client and three teammates last night. Corpcard charged $367.80 to \"RESTAURANT DORSO\" but the receipt is a single PDF with total only. Need to split between attendees for expense allocation and client billing.
Tariq (Finance): Did you ask the restaurant for an itemized bill? We need names + amounts if teammates paid personal share. Also: was this client entertainment or team dinner?
Ellen (Sales): Client was present for first 45 mins, then teammates stayed after. We want to bill client for their portion ($120) and distribute remainder among the 3 employees. I tried to get an itemized but host said kitchen printed only one total. I have the emailed receipt: https://files.redwood/receipts/dorso_2198.pdf
Lina (People Ops): Manager approval? Marta signed off earlier for client meeting budget. Marta, can you confirm?
Marta (EM): Confirmed approval for client dinner budget in Slack DM. Happy to approve client portion.
Tariq (Finance): OK. Filing rules: 1) For client-billable portion we need a short memo from you with attendee list + client name + time spent with client. 2) For internal split: submit an expense for the corpcard charge and in the notes add \"split: Ellen $82.60, TeammateA $82.60, TeammateB $82.60\" (divide remainder equally). 3) Each employee who owes must file a negative-expense or \"reimbursement owed\" entry OR you can request us to process internal chargebacks. 4) Code client portion to GL 6320-Client-Entertainment and internal to GL 6305-Staff-Events.
ExpenseBot: :warning: Expense flagged  single-receipt split requires attendee affirmation. Ticket: SPLIT-2198.
Ellen (Sales): I'll collect attendee confirmations now. Quick question  can finance do the internal chargebacks if the teammates prefer not to file separate negative expenses?
Tariq (Finance): Yes we can do chargebacks if you provide: attendee list with emails, per-person amounts, and a scanned signature or Slack confirmation line from each person (quick \"I confirm my share $82.60\" is fine). We'll queue the chargebacks and email payroll if collection needed.
Ellen (Sales): Got it. I'll paste confirmations here when I have them. Thanks.
Marta (EM): Thx. Also reminder: try to get itemized next time or use the company booking vendor for larger client meals.
Ellen (Sales): Uploaded receipt + manager approval: https://files.redwood/receipts/dorso_2198.pdf https://files.redwood/approvals/marta_dorso_2198.png
Ellen (Sales): Teammate confirmations: Jason: \"confirm $82.60\"; Priya: \"confirm $82.60\"; Omar: \"confirm $82.60\".
Tariq (Finance): Received. We'll process internal chargebacks to those emails and mark client portion for invoicing. Marking SPLIT-2198 as in-progress. Thanks!
ExpenseBot: :white_check_mark: SPLIT-2198 updated: finance assigned (Tariq), status = in_progress.
notes: Collect Slack confirmations from attendees or attach signed statement. Finance can process internal chargebacks once attendee emails + amounts provided. Client portion will be coded to GL 6320 for invoicing.
